verdict_reachability: DEFECT (see finding) -- graha_shadbala_total is NOT reachable on the tool's DEFAULT page (offset=0) or on several higher offsets tried (0, 80, 125, 250) despite being declared in the response's own top-level 'categories' array every single call. It took offset=400 (found by trial-and-error escalation: 0 -> 80 -> 125 -> 250 -> 400) to finally surface graha_shadbala_total rows. The 'limit' parameter (tested at 25000, the tool's documented max) has NO effect on the number of rows actually served -- every call regardless of limit was silently capped by an internal byte-budget trim to somewhere between 48 and 60 rows. The declared 'total' row count and 'counterfactual_rows_dropped' count also both changed between calls at different offsets for the SAME chart/ayanamsha (223 at offset=0, 208 at offset=80, 205 at offset=125, 193 at offset=250, 120 at offset=400), indicating offset is not applied to a stable, consistently-filtered row ordering.
